title: The Boy Born Without Mana
prompt: Deep within the Anti-Magic Sword Pedestal, a glowing ancient rune transmits a double-encoded signal. Decode the layers of mana to uncover Asta's true resolve.
hints: Story Clue: Asta has no magic, relying on raw strength to break through outer barriers.
Technical Clue: The ciphertext string uses characters [A-Z, a-z, 0-9, +, /, =], indicative of Base64 encoding.
Method Clue: Apply Base64 decoding twice on the ciphertext string to recover the flag.
spell_desc: Cleaves through base encodings and nullifies simple magic barriers.

title: The Four-Leaf Grimoire
prompt: Yuno has been chosen by the Legendary Four-Leaf Grimoire. The wind spirit Sylph leaves a message shifted by the sacred number of luck.

public_data.clue: The four leaves of the clover symbolize luck...

hints: Story Clue: Look at the clover on Yuno's grimoire. How many leaves does it possess?
Technical Clue: This is a classical shift cipher. Each letter is shifted by a constant numerical offset.
Method Clue: Shift every alphabetic character backwards by 4 positions (or try Caesar key 4).
spell_desc: Unleashes a cyclone that rotates alphabetical letters back into alignment.

title: Surpass Your Limits
prompt: Captain Yami of the Black Bulls draws his Dark Magic blade and carves a polyalphabetic code into the hideout wall. Use his ultimate motto as the key.
hints: Story Clue: What is Captain Yami's iconic phrase when facing impossible odds? 'Surpass your _____'
Technical Clue: This is a Vigenère cipher. The secret repeating key is a 5-letter word representing Yami's motto.
Method Clue: Decrypt the Vigenère ciphertext using the secret key word 'LIMIT'.
spell_desc: Slashes through multi-key ciphers and absorbs polyalphabetic barriers.

title: Sea Dragon's Cradle
prompt: Noelle Silva's sea dragon mana oscillates in harmonic binary waves. A hex-encoded stream of water mana guards the royal family secret.
hints: Story Clue: Noelle takes immense pride in her royal lineage. Which house does she belong to?
Technical Clue: The ciphertext is hex-encoded. Convert hex to raw bytes, then bitwise XOR with a repeated key.
Method Clue: Perform repeated-key XOR on the raw bytes using the key string 'ROYAL'.
spell_desc: Fires a concentrated torrent of water that XOR-cancels hex-encoded streams.

title: The Hideout Assembly
prompt: Finral, Magna, and Luck have each secured one fragment of the squad contract encoded with their signature magic attributes. Reconstruct the full message.
hints: Story Clue: Each squad member contributed a fragment using their unique magic style.
Technical Clue: Fragment 1 is Base64, Fragment 2 is Hexadecimal, and Fragment 3 is ROT13.
Method Clue: Decode fragment 1 (Base64), fragment 2 (Hex), and fragment 3 (ROT13), then concatenate them in order.
spell_desc: Combines multi-member spatial, fire, and lightning magic into a single strike.

title: Reincarnation & Hidden History
prompt: An ancient elven stele written in Sephirot script has emerged. Substitute the ancient characters using frequency clues embedded in the elven lore.

public_data.lore: The Elven Sephirot tablet uses an ancient character shift.

hints: Story Clue: The elven language uses a 1-to-1 letter mapping based on their ancestral alphabet.
Technical Clue: This is a monoalphabetic substitution cipher. Look at the public sample mapping.
Method Clue: Map the cipher alphabet back using the provided sample mapping: a->q, b->w, c->e, d->r, e->t.
spell_desc: Illuminates ancient substitution alphabets and reveals true historical texts.

title: Word Soul Devil
prompt: Zagred attempts to summon word soul magic using a flawed RSA public key with a small modulus. Factor N to break his forbidden spell.

public_data.note: Small modulus N can be factored easily into p and q.

hints: Story Clue: Devil magic seems infinite, but Zagred's modulus N is surprisingly small and vulnerable.
Technical Clue: Public key N = 3233, e = 17. Find prime factors p and q such that N = p * q.
Method Clue: N = 61 * 53. Calculate phi = 60 * 52 = 3120, find private exponent d = 2753, then decrypt each c^d mod N.
spell_desc: Factors prime moduli and dismantles devilish public key cryptosystems.

title: The Five-Leaf Devil Contract
prompt: Liebe's devil binding contract is encrypted with symmetric AES-128-CBC. Extract the key derived from his anti-magic bond.
hints: Story Clue: Liebe is Asta's anti-magic devil brother. His key is built from his core identity.
Technical Clue: AES-128-CBC mode require a 16-byte key and 16-byte IV. Hex IV is provided in public data.
Method Clue: Decrypt the hex ciphertext using AES-128-CBC with Key = 'anti_magic_liebe' (16 bytes) and IV from public data.
spell_desc: Slashes through block ciphers and decrypts AES devil contracts using anti-magic.

title: Spade Kingdom's Shadows
prompt: Dante, Vanica, and Zenon have sealed the underworld gates with MD5, SHA-1, and SHA-256 hashes. Identify and crack each hash to breach the dark realm.

public_data.note: Reconstruct the full flag by combining Part 1 + Part 2 + Part 3 once verified.

hints: Story Clue: Each of the 3 Dark Triad members controls one hash stage of the seal.
Technical Clue: Dante uses MD5, Vanica uses SHA-1, Zenon uses SHA-256. Public data provides the exact structure.
Method Clue: Combine Part 1 (Dante) + Part 2 (Vanica) + Part 3 (Zenon) as listed in the public wordlist hints.
spell_desc: Cracks devil hashes and collapses spatial gravity barriers.

title: The Flow of Ki
prompt: In Hino Country, Ryudo Ryuya teaches you to sense ki. An array of numerical ki coordinates conceals the secret of Zetten.
hints: Story Clue: Zetten focuses ki by multiplying force and adding a directional offset.
Technical Clue: Each character ASCII value c was transformed using E(c) = (c * 7) + 13.
Method Clue: For each integer E in the array, compute c = (E - 13) // 7 and convert back to ASCII characters.
spell_desc: Channels ki into integer transformations and reverses numeric affine shifts.

title: Soul & Time Distortion
prompt: Lucius Zogratis manipulates time and soul magic across a 3-layer cipher chain: Base64 -> XOR(key='TIME') -> Hex. Reverse time to undo his grand design.
hints: Story Clue: Lucius controls time magic. To solve his cipher, you must move backwards through time.
Technical Clue: The pipeline was: Flag -> Base64 -> XOR with 'TIME' -> Hex string.
Method Clue: Reverse the process: Convert hex to bytes, XOR bytes with key 'TIME', then Base64 decode the resulting string.
spell_desc: Rewinds cipher pipelines and shatters time-layered encryption.

title: The Ultimate Anti-Magic Spell
prompt: The Forbidden Grimoire unlocks its final page. Combine the 5 Master Spell Keys collected throughout your journey to break the ultimate devil seal!
hints: Story Clue: Recall the key spell terms unlocked in Chapters 1, 3, 7, 8, and 11.
Technical Clue: Combined key string = 'asta_no_magic' + '_' + 'dark_magic' + '_' + 'word_soul' + '_' + 'five_leaf' + '_' + 'time_magic'.
Method Clue: Base64 decode the ciphertext, then XOR the resulting bytes with the repeating Combined Key string.
spell_desc: The supreme power of the Black Bulls Grimoire. Nullifies all magic and unifies all squad spell keys.
